forecast.reasoning: Carlos Roberto Massa Júnior (known as 'Ratinho Junior' or simply 'Massa') is not a major contender for the 2026 Brazilian presidency. The race is structured around Lula (incumbent, PT) vs Tarcisio de Freitas (São Paulo governor, center-right) as the top two, with Renan Santos as a far-right Bolsonaro legacy candidate. Massa has no national profile, no party machinery, and no polling above single digits. The Brazilian two-round system requires either first-round majority (impossible for a minor candidate in a crowded field) or top-two finish to make runoff. With Lula's 40-45% base and Tarcisio's institutional advantages, the top-two positions are locked. Confidence 0.999 — essentially a freebie. The 0.1% market price appropriately prices this as near-impossible. The high volume ($9.9M) reflects market-making activity, not genuine uncertainty.
